scope: Synthetic presentation decision screen, 12 labelled cases; 2 repeats for decision APIs, 1 for matched Qwen tool baseline. Same request across decision APIs, Qwen uses equivalent choice tool schema. Network latency for hosted APIs; local Laya CPU end-to-end latency. Labels are developer-authored, not independent human evaluation. No calibrated threshold claims.
